property: The independent validator must demonstrate user-controlled command execution with a positive side effect and a benign negative control.

validation.reproducerCommand: python -c 'from pathlib import Path; from types import SimpleNamespace as S; from src.app import run; result=run(S(body=S(command="printf validated > /tmp/evo-audit-positive"))); assert result.returncode == 0 and Path("/tmp/evo-audit-positive").read_text() == "validated"'
validation.negativeControlCommand: python -c 'from types import SimpleNamespace as S; from src.app import run; result=run(S(body=S(command="printf safe"))); assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == "safe"'

notes: The positive control writes only to the validator tmpfs; the source mount remains read-only.
The sandbox denies network and does not fall back to host execution.
